parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>  If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the request fails. If no Overview page exists or no instance ID is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For more information, see the [Overview](~~356505~~) topic of IoT instances.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices belong.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-lora-nodes-task --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-info DevEui=d896e0efff000000 PinCode=123000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateLoRaNodesTask --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceInfo.1.DevEui d896e0efff000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --DeviceInfo.1.PinCode 123000 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
